tobaccoGuidePage.beginWithTheInteriorInT: Begin with the interior. In the configurator, combine two to five filler leaves to build your selection.
tobaccoGuidePage.continueWithTheBinderOn: Continue with the binder: one leaf that surrounds the filler and holds the whole together.
tobaccoGuidePage.finishWithTheWrapperThi: Finish with the wrapper. This outer leaf surrounds the whole and gives the cigar its final appearance.
tobaccoGuidePage.discoverWhatEachLeafCon: Discover what each leaf contributes, explore different profiles and return to your blend with a clearer idea.
tobaccoGuidePage.tapALayerToDiscoverItsF: Tap a layer to discover its function.
tobaccoGuidePage.eachLeafContributesAPar: Each leaf contributes a part. The blend tells the story.
tobaccoGuidePage.yourBlendIsPreservedWhe: Your blend is preserved when you close the guide.
tobaccoFamilyGallery.exploreAvailableLea: Explore available leaves by their role in your blend.
tobaccoFamiliesInfo.varietyAndCuringHelp: Variety and curing help explain the differences between tobaccos. This comparison introduces four general profiles; it does not mean all are in our collection.
tobaccoFamiliesInfo.originCultivationAnd: Origin, cultivation and processing can change a leaf’s expression. A family describes a general profile; wrapper, binder and filler describe its function in the cigar.
